text: Dear Chair and Members of Toronto and East York Community Council, I am kindly asking for your support of my motion to authorize the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) along Rushton Road, between Maplewood Avenue and Humewood Gardens. I have heard from many neighbours along Rushton Road that additional speed humps are required along the block to respond to increased speeds and reckless driving. Residents of Rushton Road have previously demonstrated their strong support for traffic calming along their street. With the passage of this motion, the community will receive the traffic calming measures they have been organizing for.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (two additional speed humps) on Rushton Road, between Maplewood Avenue and Humewood Gardens, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 7, 2026) from Councillor Josh Matlow.
